transcript: Speaker A: Thank you everyone, if you liked my performance. A for apple, B for ball jaisi English toh seekh li, lekin aaj tak English mein dhang se sentence tak nahi bol paate ho. Aise toh tumhari koi izzat nahi karega. Isse accha tum aaj ke aaj is app pe roz sirf 15 minute English practice karke dekho. Dekhna phir kaise farratedar English bolte ho. Is app ko English Seekho app kehte hain. Yahan sirf sikhane wali video aati hain, koi ads nahi aati. English Seekho app pe spoken English yaani bolne wali angrezi ka ek show aata hai. Experts chhote-chhote video mein step-by-step English bolna sikhate hain. Toh bas roz ka 15 minute nikalo, expert ke video dekho, AI coach se practice karo. Trial sirf ek rupaye ka hai. Phir dekhna kuch dino mein tumhari English dekh ke log dang reh jayenge. [You learned basic English words but can't speak full sentences. No one will respect you like this. Instead, practice 15 minutes daily on this app. It's called English Seekho, has no ads, offers step-by-step expert videos, AI coaching, and a 1-rupee trial.] Speaker B: Toh install button par click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW. Disclaimer: English Seekho kisi bhi government authority, institution, brand, organisation ya individual ke dwara endorsed nahi hai. [English Seekho, INSTALL NOW. Disclaimer: English Seekho is not endorsed by any government authority, institution, brand, or organization.]
summary: An elderly street musician warns viewers that knowing basic English words is not enough to earn respect. He recommends the English Seekho app for daily 15-minute practice with expert videos and an AI coach. The ad concludes with a call to install the app for a 1-rupee trial.
